# `usage_bar`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The barring (suspend) and lifting (restore) a pay-as-you-go line gets from its balance: at zero or below the line is barred on the network, above zero it is restored. One row per command, numbered per product; the latest row is the line's barring state. Sent by the billing worker through the network adapter; the id is the idempotency key.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `seq` | `integer` | no |  | Order of the commands of the line, from 1; the id derives from product and seq. |
| `kind` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `state` | `text` | no | `'pending'::text` | pending (to send, or retried after a temporary error), confirmed, refused (final: the network said no; nothing is sent again automatically) or cancelled (the line ended before it was sent). |
| `request` | `jsonb` | yes |  | The request as first sent; every retry resends it unchanged. |
| `attempts` | `integer` | no | `0` |  |
| `next_attempt_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  | Earliest next attempt after a temporary error. |
| `last_error` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `refusal_code` | `text` | yes |  |  |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `confirmed_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | yes |  |  |
